title: WCPFC North Pacific Swordfish Management Strategy Evaluation
text:
This site hosts the materials for the Management Strategy Evaluation (MSE) process for North Pacific swordfish (Xiphias gladius), managed by the Western and Central Pacific Fisheries Commission (WCPFC).
The MSE tests candidate management procedures against a range of plausible operating models to evaluate their performance against management objectives under uncertainty.

title: WCPFC North Pacific Swordfish Management Strategy Evaluation
text:
Materials

Trial Specifications Document: the operating models, management procedures, and performance metrics used in the MSE.

Repository Structure
The wcpfcNSWO repository is organised as follows:







Directory / File
Purpose




R/
Package functions and objects.


analysis/
Analysis scripts that run the MSE


data-raw/
Stock assessment conditioning model output


objects/
Saved R objects produced by the analysis scripts (OM/, Hist/, etc.)


tsd/
Quarto source for the Trial Specifications Document


homepage/
Quarto source for this website



To reproduce the analysis, download the wcpfcNSWO repository, and work through the scripts in analysis.
